# PROBRIDGE

> PROBRIDGE ("We Connect World of Real Estate") is a real-estate advisory and authorised channel partner based in Chennai, India. It connects people with property buying, selling, rental, interior and home-maintenance services without brokerage charges, and lists verified new residential projects and plots in Chennai, Bengaluru and Pune.

- Contact: phone +91 76670 05000, WhatsApp +91 72001 41515, email projects@probridge.co.in
- Office: First Floor, No. 10B, Ekambaram Industrial Estate Rd, Alapakkam, Karpaga Vinayagar Colony, Valasaravakkam, Chennai, Tamil Nadu 600116
- Builder alliances: Prestige Group, Brigade Group, Godrej Properties, Puravankara
- Prices, EMIs and availability on listing pages are indicative and subject to developer confirmation.

## Main pages

- [PROBRIDGE | Buy, Sell & Explore Properties Without Brokerage](https://www.probridge.co.in/test/): Explore property buying, selling, rental services, new projects and plots with PROBRIDGE. Connect with trusted real-estate brands and property services.
- [New Properties for Sale | Verified Apartments & Villas](https://www.probridge.co.in/test/properties.html): Browse newly launched verified apartments and villas in Chennai, Bengaluru and Pune from Godrej, Prestige, Brigade, Puravankara and more. Zero brokerage with PROBRIDGE.
- [Plots for Sale in Chennai | DTCP & RERA Approved Plots](https://www.probridge.co.in/test/plots.html): Search approved plots for sale in Chennai by locality and budget — OMR, Oragadam, Ambattur, GST Road and more. Zero brokerage with PROBRIDGE.
